auth.heroText: Profiles, leave, attendance, payroll and recruitment for every factory and office employee.

heroPoints.mobile: Submit and approve leave requests on your phone
heroPoints.payslip: See your monthly payslip as soon as it is published

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your company email to sign in.
auth.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.forgotPasswordPending: Password reset is under development. Please contact the HR department.
auth.demoHint: Click an email to fill it in. Shared password: Demo@2026.

errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account temporarily locked after too many failed sign-ins. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Please contact the system administrator.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: Your account is not allowed to open this page. Contact your system administrator if you need access.

roles.intro: Each role combines functional permissions with a data scope. Changes take effect when users refresh their session (up to 15 minutes).

hints.code: Uppercase letters, digits or underscores, e.g. SHIFT_LEAD. Cannot be changed later.
hints.dataScope: Limits which data holders of this role can see and act on.
hints.systemScope: System roles keep a fixed data scope.
hints.adminLocked: The System administrator role always keeps role management so nobody is locked out of this screen.
hints.inUse: Assigned to {{count}} users; remove it from them before deleting.

validation.codePattern: 2–50 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter
validation.permissionsRequired: Please select at least one permission.

roles.confirmDelete: Delete role "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

users.effectNote: New roles take effect when the user refreshes their session (up to 15 minutes).

validation.roleRequired: A user must have at least one role.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: Someone else just changed this data. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ROLE_NO_PERMISSION: A role needs at least one permission.
errors.ROLE_ADMIN_MUST_MANAGE_ROLES: The System administrator role must keep role management.
errors.ROLE_SYSTEM_SCOPE_LOCKED: The data scope of a system role cannot be changed.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is assigned to {{assignedUserCount}} users. Remove it from them before deleting.
errors.USER_NO_ROLE: A user must have at least one role.
errors.USER_SELF_LOCKOUT: You cannot remove the role that lets you manage accounts from yourself.
errors.AUDIT_RANGE_INVALID: The start date must be on or before the end date.
errors.AUDIT_ENTITY_UNKNOWN: This table is not in the audit log.

audit.intro: Every create, update, delete and sign-in is recorded: who, when, which table, values before and after. The log cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No log entries match the filters.

departments.title: Organization
departments.dragHint: Drag a department onto another to change its parent, or use "Move to…".
departments.dropToRoot: Drop here to make it a top-level department

hints.code: Uppercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, e.g. PRINT-SHOP.
hints.move: Only valid targets are listed: not itself, its sub-units or inactive departments.

departments.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate "{{name}}"? It will be hidden from the tree but its history is kept.

hints.code: Upper-case letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, e.g. KS-QC.

positions.noGrades: There are no active job grades. Add a grade first.

validation.codePattern: Code must be 2–30 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens
validation.nameTooLong: Position name must be at most 150 characters

positions.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate position "{{name}}"? Employees holding it are not affected.
positions.confirmDelete: Delete position "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

jobGrades.intro: Each job grade has a salary range. A position uses the salary range of its grade.

hints.code: Upper-case letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, e.g. G3.
hints.money: Enter whole dong, e.g. 12.000.000. For a single-point range enter the same amount twice.

validation.codePattern: Code must be 2–20 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens
validation.nameTooLong: Grade name must be at most 100 characters
validation.money: Enter a whole amount greater than 0, at most 15 digits
validation.range: Maximum salary must be greater than or equal to the minimum

jobGrades.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate grade "{{name}}"? New positions can no longer use it.
jobGrades.confirmDelete: Delete grade "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

errors.DEPARTMENT_MOVE_CYCLE: A department cannot be moved into itself or one of its sub-units.
errors.DEPARTMENT_HAS_CHILDREN: This department has {{childCount}} sub-units. Move or delete them first.
errors.DEPARTMENT_HAS_EMPLOYEES: This department has had {{employeeCount}} employees and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.DEPARTMENT_HAS_ACTIVE_EMPLOYEES: This department still has {{employeeCount}} working employees. Transfer them first.
errors.DEPARTMENT_IN_USE: This department is referenced elsewhere and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.JOB_GRADE_SALARY_INVALID: Salary must be a whole amount greater than 0, at most 15 digits.
errors.JOB_GRADE_RANGE_INVALID: Minimum salary cannot exceed the maximum.
errors.JOB_GRADE_HAS_POSITIONS: This grade has {{positionCount}} positions and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.JOB_GRADE_HAS_ACTIVE_POSITIONS: This grade still has {{positionCount}} active positions. Move or deactivate them first.
errors.JOB_GRADE_IN_USE: This grade is used elsewhere and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.POSITION_GRADE_REQUIRED: A position must belong to one of the company's job grades.
errors.POSITION_GRADE_INACTIVE: The job grade is inactive. Choose another grade or reactivate it.
errors.POSITION_HAS_EMPLOYEES: This position has {{employeeCount}} employees and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.POSITION_IN_USE: This position is used elsewhere and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

chart.search: Find an employee on the chart

hints.code: Next suggested code; you can change it. Uppercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
hints.statusCreate: A new profile starts on probation or as permanent.
hints.statusUpdate: Leaving the company is handled in the offboarding feature, not here.

profile.personalHidden: Date of birth, personal email, phone and address are visible only to HR and the employee.

validation.codePattern: 2–30 characters: letters, digits, underscore or hyphen
validation.fullNameTooLong: Full name is at most 150 characters
validation.phonePattern: Phone number has 9–15 digits and may start with +
validation.birthDate: Date of birth must be before the hire date and not in the future

errors.EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND: Employee not found, or the profile is outside your data scope.
errors.EMPLOYEE_CODE_INVALID: Employee code: 2–30 uppercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
errors.EMPLOYEE_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter the full name (at most 150 characters).
errors.EMPLOYEE_WORK_EMAIL_EXISTS: The work email is already used by another employee.
errors.EMPLOYEE_BIRTH_DATE_INVALID: Date of birth must be before the hire date and not in the future.
errors.EMPLOYEE_PHONE_INVALID: Phone number has 9–15 digits and may start with +.
errors.EMPLOYEE_STATUS_NOT_ALLOWED: This status cannot be chosen. Leaving is handled in the offboarding feature.
errors.EMPLOYEE_DEPARTMENT_INACTIVE: The department is inactive. Choose another department.
errors.EMPLOYEE_POSITION_INACTIVE: The position is inactive. Choose another position.
errors.EMPLOYEE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The department is outside the data scope you manage.
